scenes.card: The platform team|What you can do
scenes.text: This guide is for the platform team, the super admins.

scenes.title: All organizations
scenes.text: You see every organization, its users and programs, and set its payment terms.

scenes.title: Money
scenes.text: You approve large withdrawals and refunds, see what every organization has been paid, and look after the platform fund.

scenes.title: Care and oversight
scenes.text: You read the inbox, switch maintenance mode on when needed, check backups, and review the audit log.
